تستفعلون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْعِلُونَ (tastafʕilūna) /tas.taf.ʕi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# تُسْتَفْعَلُونَ (tustafʕalūna) /tus.taf.ʕa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
